title: The Puzzling Nazca Lines

scenes.text: Over 800 ancient geoglyphs seen from above?
The largest Nazca figure measures 1,200 feet in length.
They were created between 500 BC and 500 AD, but their purpose is still unclear.
Some theories link them to astronomy!
Follow for the cases no one can explain.

description: The Nazca Lines are a marvel of ancient engineering, yet their purpose remains a mystery. Could they have celestial connections? Join us to explore this ancient wonder! #shorts #NazcaLines #ancienthistory #geoglyphs #fyp
